name: Xbox Elite Series 2
subtitle: 045e:0b00 / 0b22
_comment: The second controller layout, and the proof that adding one is a file and
not a code change: Panel.qml reads every *.json in this directory and
names no controller anywhere. The daemon publishes which layout is live in
`status.json` (`"layout": "xbox-elite-2"` while an Xbox pad is the
active source) and `hyprpad-cheatsheet` forwards it in the summon payload.
Differences from steam-controller-2026.json, all of them data:
* NO `lpad`, `rpad`, `lpad_click`, `rpad_click`, `quickaccess`. This pad
has none of them. A Steam-Controller-flavoured config summoned with
this layout still shows those bindings — the widget parks anything it
cannot anchor
in `overflow` (Sheet.qml) — it just cannot point at them.
* The sticks and the d-pad move: the Elite's left stick is HIGH and its
d-pad sits below it, mirrored on the right. On this pad the sticks are
also what drives the cursor and scrolling, so `lstick`/`rstick` are
load-bearing here in a way they are not on the Steam Controller.
* `steam` is the XBOX button. hyprpad's control id is unchanged, because
the guide is a role and not a brand — every `guide+...` chord in a
config works on either controller with no edit.
* The four paddles keep hyprpad's grip names. On the controller itself
they are lettered P1-P4, and the correspondence — the one SDL and the
Linux kernel both settled on — is P1=R4, P2=R5, P3=L4, P4=L5: the
UPPER pair first, then the lower. The drawing carries a back-view inset
lettered P1-P4 next to callouts that say L4/L5/R4/R5, which is the one
place a reader has to translate between the silkscreen and the config.
The paddles reach hyprpad only in the controller's profile slot 0 (no LED)
and only over USB, or over Bluetooth with udev-hid-bpf installed. See
docs/design/xbox-elite.md.
_art_comment: One entry, unlike the Steam Controller's two. Steam ships an Elite diagram —
it is a RASTER, and the widget recolours SVG strokes to theme the drawing,
The bundled file is NOT a hyprpad drawing. Its pad is Xelu's Xbox Series X
diagram (CC0), adapted; the back-view paddle inset under it is ours. No
openly-licensed drawing of an Elite Series 2 exists — the Elite's front
face is a Series pad, which is why a Series diagram is the right base. See

art.credit: Xbox Series X diagram by Nicolae (Xelu) Berbece, CC0; paddle inset hyprpad's own

_controls_comment: Not eyeballed. Xelu's diagram is eight compound paths; splitting them into
their 60 subpaths and taking each subpath's bounding-box centre hands you
the whole map in the drawing's own coordinates — sticks, d-pad and its four
directions, the four face circles, both bumpers, both trigger nubs, View,
Menu and the guide ring. The recipe is docs/research/controller-art.md §7.4;
the numbers below are its output rounded to whole units.
The four paddles are the exception: they are ours, drawn in the inset, and
their anchors are the blade tips plus the inset's 140-unit offset.
`hidden` (dashed leader) now marks ONLY the triggers. It used to mark the
paddles too, because a front view cannot show them — the inset is exactly
the fix for that, so their leaders are solid again.
_modifiers_comment: `guide` says 'hold Xbox' rather than 'hold Steam' — the same modifier, the
name the reader's thumb is actually on.

osk.legend: while the on-screen keyboard is up

_glyphs_comment: Not one new art file. Kenney's Input Prompts set (art/kenney/, CC0 —
see ../art/LICENSES.md) turns out to already be right for an Xbox pad:
* the A/B/X/Y chips are lettered circles, and the Elite's face diamond
carries the same four letters in the same four positions as the Steam
* `steam_lb.svg` and `steam_lt.svg` literally draw the strings 'LB' and
'LT' — Xbox's own naming — so l1/l2 need nothing else;
* the d-pad, stick and stick-press chips are plain shapes with no
* `controller_button_l4/l5/r4/r5.svg` are the generic grip pills, and the
grip names are what a hyprpad config spells, so they are the right
label even though the controller's own silkscreen says P1-P4.
So this layout adds no glyph at all: the only new art is the drawing, and
most of that was found rather than drawn. The `text` fallbacks name the
Xbox control, for a checkout with the art stripped.
